entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-09-30
entry.content:

  • Evaluate xUnit v3 TestContext for Razor parser test setup #85856
  • Unions: a generic union instantiated with case types that differ only by nullable annotations is accepted #85854

  • MSBuildWorkspace tests fail with ProjectCacheService DisposeAsync TypeLoadException #85848
